notes.title: MR Support and Visual Update
notes.notes:
[h1]Yeah yeah, not as big of an update but still.[/h1]

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l4pTa8gtdU1INtZBK/giphy.gif[/img]

Due to requests to add MR support ASAP, we decided to split the update and deliver MR controllers support first.

This small update also includes enhanced visuals for the rooms and FPS improvement overall.


[h1]What's next?[/h1]


Currently we are working on Table Tennis physics update. Recently we've got a very concrete feedback on it and on Foosball, however, it is most likely, those updates will come out separately. 

We would love to hear more of your feedback to improve the experience in VR Table Sports, so feel free to join our Discord for a quick support and feedbacks!

https://discord.gg/wHaBmgx

Thank you everyone who reached out to us and gave us an opportunity to further enhance and polish our game.

Again, we are sorry for inconvenience and are very grateful for your patience.


Have a nice play!

notes.title: IMPORTANT UPDATE - Improved Foosball
notes.notes:
Hello There! 

We have reconsidered and reworked [b]Foosball[/b].
In this update we tried to make it as [i]real[/i] as possible. 

1. Now game is based  purely on physics. There are no more bugs and glitches like: ball sticking. It also changed main mechanics of the game.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/l1J9HByxXMJ2efptK/giphy.gif[/img]

2. Handlers are remade too and now they are returning to their original position by gravity. Starting interaction with handlers will not cause rotation snapping as it was in past versions, it will behave more like in real life.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/3o7aD34HeOCFnoJRrG/giphy.gif[/img]
 
3. Improved  controls - Now you can swing rods naturally with your hands.

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29694106/a6d11b7ab9dd778e891989be4640e8f7468a25a2.gif[/img]

4. Also in this update you can change interaction buttons in options to set things up more comfortable.

5. Slightly updated AI - fixed kick motions and adjusted difficulties.

6. Fixed noticeable bugs in multiplayer mode.

Besides Foosball there are fixed minor bugs as well.
